info.title: Sentinel Vault API
info.description: The API accepts encrypted vault envelopes only. Cookie mutations require Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Device bearer tokens are restricted to vault operations.

parameters.name: x-csrf-token
parameters.description: Required on browser-session mutations together with the canonical Origin. Device bearer requests omit it.
